note: SPG7 and other mitochondrial spastic paraplegias frequently manifest optic neuropathy, whereas SPG93 encompasses pure to complex presentations whose optic atrophy frequency requires formal cohort synthesis.

evidence.text: In SPG7-positive patients, optic neuropathy or optical coherence tomography abnormalities were identified in all tested individuals, supporting high optic nerve involvement in SPG7.

source.title: Spastic paraplegia gene 7 in patients with spasticity and/or optic neuropathy
source.quote: All SPG7-positive patients tested had optic neuropathy or abnormalities revealed by optical coherence tomography, indicating that abnormalities in optical coherence tomography could be a clinical biomarker for SPG7 testing.

numbers.metric: SPG7 patients with optic neuropathy or OCT abnormalities

evidence.text: Human Phenotype Ontology records optic atrophy features in SPG93 (OMIM:620938) with a frequency classification of Frequent, which may challenge the assertion of low (<20%) prevalence.
